# Google Maps images (and YouTube) — hand-maintained, NOT generated by tools/build-blocklists.mjs.
# Opt-in group: off until switched on (FilterSettings.DEFAULT_OFF_GROUPS).
# `*.example.com` blocks example.com itself and every subdomain.
#
# Image hosts used by Google Maps photos, Street View thumbnails and image results.
# The same hosts also serve Gmail / Play Store / profile images and YouTube thumbnails.
*.encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com
*.encrypted-tbn1.gstatic.com
*.encrypted-tbn2.gstatic.com
*.encrypted-tbn3.gstatic.com
*.ggpht.com
*.gz0.googleusercontent.com
*.lh3.googleusercontent.com
*.lh4.googleusercontent.com
*.lh5.googleusercontent.com
*.lh6.googleusercontent.com
# YouTube website and video streams
*.www.youtube.com
*.googlevideo.com
